semantic_slots.target: Source, actual module, exact lesson fold and final expanded blind reconstruction agree: the same effect probability at approximate/exact primitive evaluations differs by at most real exact.length*delta. BornStability is a real consumer dependency.
semantic_slots.normalization: Public inputs retain norm-one psi, 0<=P<=I, delta>=0 and the supplied Aligned certificate. Actual proof derives both evaluated circuit unitaries and the operator error through existing library theorems; those are not public hypotheses.
semantic_slots.registers: Actual PrimitiveBasis n is Fin n -> Fin 2; P and psi use that same fixed basis. Evaluation is eval(rest)*eval(head). Positionwise Forall2 alignment preserves constructors, targets and length. Expanded decoder reconstructs these exact ambient definitions.
semantic_slots.oracles: A supplied alignment witness is required. No automatic synthesis/alignment producer, controlled/inverse oracle access model or black-box algorithm is present in source, Lean or reconstruction.
semantic_slots.ancillas_phases: The existing basis and one-wire lifting are preserved; no new ancilla or garbage subsystem is introduced. The theorem accepts circuits, not PrimitiveProgram with independent global phases, and supplies no quotient/phase representative choice.
semantic_slots.error_success: Only unchanged gates or same-target Ry pairs with absolute evaluated-real angle error<=delta align. The actual existing telescoping theorem gives exact.length*delta/2; derived unitarity and BornStability give exact.length*delta. Decoder accurately limits its formal-only helper reconstruction; reviewer independently checked that imported helper. No stochastic success claim follows.
semantic_slots.resources: Exact length counts every list entry and is only the analytic coefficient, including unchanged gates. ExactAngle supports arbitrary reals; no finite-bit rounding procedure, runtime, loading/shot cost, physical depth or hardware noise theorem is claimed.
